initial_inventory.title: [Kernel] Preserve BF16 checkpoint weights in small SM70 linear operators

metadata.title: [Kernel] Preserve BF16 checkpoint weights in small SM70 linear operators
metadata.body:
Add SM70 reference operators that retain original two-byte BF16 weight storage and expand values directly into FP32 registers. Cover small-M dense projections and reuse the existing MTP expert projection implementation with a BF16 decoder; activation/output boundaries remain FP16.

Fifteen research-extension GPU numerical checks pass, including graph replay, an FP64 oracle and bitwise FP16 specialization regression checks. Formal installed-package validation, real-activation timing and model integration remain pending. No model route or speedup is claimed. The compact BF16 reader is retained for later precision comparison; the initial Flash-Next MTP4 baseline uses the existing FP16 load path.
